/* v1.3.22 compact settings hub */
.calendar-legend i.upcoming{background:#eab308!important;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(234,179,8,.12)}.calendar-event.upcoming span{background:#eab308!important}.history-match-list{display:grid;gap:12px}.history-match{display:grid;gap:8px}.history-match-head{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px}.history-match-head b{font-size:12px}.history-duration{white-space:nowrap}.schedule-tap{text-decoration:none;color:inherit}.settings-hub{display:grid;gap:10px;padding:0 24px 110px}.settings-tile{width:100%;display:grid;grid-template-columns:44px 1fr auto;align-items:center;gap:12px;text-align:left;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;background:var(--surface);color:var(--text);padding:14px 15px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);font:inherit}.settings-tile-icon{width:44px;height:44px;display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:14px;background:var(--soft);font-weight:950}.settings-tile-copy{display:grid;gap:3px;min-width:0}.settings-tile-copy b{font-size:15px}.settings-tile-copy small{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)}.settings-chevron{font-size:30px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1}.danger-tile .settings-tile-icon{background:rgba(220,38,38,.11);color:#b91c1c}.settings-modal{border:0;background:transparent;padding:0;width:min(100% - 20px,620px);max-width:620px;max-height:90dvh}.settings-modal::backdrop{background:rgba(0,0,0,.58);backdrop-filter:blur(4px)}.settings-sheet{background:var(--surface);color:var(--text);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:26px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 24px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.32);max-height:88dvh;display:grid;grid-template-rows:auto minmax(0,1fr)}.settings-sheet-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:18px 18px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}.settings-sheet-head h2{margin:2px 0 0;font-size:23px}.settings-close{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--soft);color:var(--text);font-size:25px;line-height:1}.settings-sheet-body{padding:16px 18px 24px;overflow:auto;display:grid;gap:16px}.settings-subsection{display:grid;gap:12px}.settings-subsection h3{margin:0;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.04em;text-transform:uppercase}.three-colors{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:8px}.three-colors label{font-size:11px}.three-colors input[type=color]{width:100%;height:54px}.account-summary{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:12px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;background:var(--soft)}.compact-install{margin:0}.history-modal .settings-sheet{height:min(88dvh,760px)}@media(max-width:420px){.settings-hub{padding-left:16px;padding-right:16px}.settings-modal{width:calc(100% - 12px)}.settings-sheet{border-radius:22px}.schedule-actions.three{grid-template-columns:1fr}.history-match-head{align-items:center}}

sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS admin_remember_tokens (selector CHAR(24) PRIMARY KEY, admin_user_id INT NOT NULL, token_hash CHAR(64) NOT NULL, expires_at DATETIME NOT NULL, created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, last_used_at DATETIME NULL, KEY idx_admin_remember_user(admin_user_id), KEY idx_admin_remember_expiry(expires_at)) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4
